_rule: PERMANENT WIRE LEDGER. A tag is written into bytes 8-9 of every DATA_BLOCK and decodes .ffhr streams forever. Never change an existing value. Never reuse a retired one. New tags append at the _next_id of their band. Removing a type from FHIR does NOT free its tag.
_scope: Covers the WHOLE FHIR spec (R4 union R5), never just the compiled profile. The emitted FF_Recovery.hpp is therefore identical for every FASTFHIR_PRODUCTION_PROFILE -- a permanent wire artifact must not depend on build configuration. Primitive and scalar tags are FastFHIR's own concepts, hand-seeded here, not discovered from StructureDefinitions.
_provenance: Seeded 2026-08-14 from the hand-maintained include/FF_Recovery.hpp, preserving all 166 values as they stood after the band re-cut (TASKS.md A27.5c). Every tag after that was appended by discovery.
